Name: Room 1
Notes: ROUND AN (Anthony, 10 Oct: the Dorms screen - 10 beds a room, buy single beds and extra rooms). ONE ROW PER ROOM, in the order they are bought; each room is a tab (1, 2, 3 ...) on the Dorms screen. Price 0 = yours from the first minute. BEDS INCLUDED = beds that come with the room; the rest of its places are bought one at a time (dorm_bed_price in Tuning.csv). A room holds dorm_beds_per_room beds (10), and there are at most dorm_max_rooms rooms (10), however many rows you write.
